title: Trump and Vance Mark Veterans Day With Arlington Wreath-Laying and Remarks
dek: The president and vice president laid a wreath at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier and spoke at Arlington National Cemetery on Wednesday, as House leaders prepared an all-member veterans tribute.
author: Meridian Newsroom
keyPoints: President Donald Trump and first lady Melania Trump took part in a wreath-laying at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier at Arlington National Cemetery on Veterans Day, the Associated Press reported.
Trump and Vice President JD Vance delivered remarks at the ceremony; Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and Chairman of the Joint Chiefs Gen. Dan Caine attended, NBC News reported.
House Speaker Mike Johnson and Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries were scheduled to lead an all-member tribute to veterans on the House steps Wednesday afternoon, NBC News reported.
The ceremony came as the Kennedy family moved to join the legal challenge to Trump’s planned arch near Arlington; the Justice Department had no comment on that filing, CBS reported.
body:
President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance marked Veterans Day at Arlington National Cemetery on Wednesday with a wreath-laying and remarks.

## Ceremony

The president took part in a wreath-laying at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, the [Associated Press](https://www.fox5atlanta.com/news/trump-leads-veterans-day-wreath-laying-ceremony-arlington-national-cemetery) reported, citing its own coverage. The first lady, Melania Trump, and Second Lady Usha Vance also attended, according to [The Hill](https://thehill.com/video-clips/6213100-watch-live-donald-trump-veterans-day-arlington-national-cemetery/), which said the ceremony included Trump’s remarks honoring service members and military organizations. NBC News reported that Hegseth and Gen. Dan Caine stood with the president during the ceremony.

## Capitol observance

House Speaker Mike Johnson and Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries were scheduled to lead an all-member tribute to veterans on the House steps Wednesday afternoon, [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trump-administration/live-blog/trump-vance-veterans-day-congress-2026-election-live-updates-rcna608667) reported.

## Context

The Arlington observance came on the same day members of the Kennedy family asked to join a lawsuit against Trump’s planned triumphal arch, arguing it would obstruct sightlines from the eternal flame at the John F. Kennedy grave. The Justice Department had no comment on that filing, CBS News reported.

## Holiday context

Veterans Day was observed Wednesday, Nov. 11, 2026. The Arlington ceremony at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier is one of the annual observances at the cemetery, and the president and vice president spoke alongside service members and military organizations, according to the reporting cited above.

The Capitol observance was scheduled separately, with Speaker Johnson and Leader Jeffries leading an all-member tribute on the House steps Wednesday afternoon.

The holiday also fell in a week of leadership changes on Capitol Hill. NBC News reported that Republican lawmakers elected Rep. Jim Jordan of Ohio to lead their House minority and re-elected Sen. John Thune of South Dakota as their Senate leader, while some Democrats called for a shake-up at the top of their caucus. In a separate NBC report that morning, Latino advocacy organizations urged the next Congress to subpoena White House chief of staff Stephen Miller over deportation actions, citing the midterm vote of Latino voters.
